title: Computer Control
switchDesc: Let the AI operate this machine's desktop via screenshots, clicks and keyboard (applies to new sessions). The companion skill is installed into the ZCode skills directory.
onHint: Click to disable (new sessions won't get the tools)
offHint: Click to enable (new sessions will get the tools)
notePermission: The permission mode follows your selection in the session toolbar; switch to "Ask before changes" if you want to confirm each action.
noteNewSession: Computer control injection applies to newly created sessions only; running sessions are unchanged.
inputButtonTitle: Show computer control button in input box
inputButtonDesc: Shows a "Computer Control" entry at the top of the input box; clicking it inserts the computer control skill. Requires computer control to be enabled first.
